mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sightings ( cat_id, photo_url, embedding, memo, tags, latitude, longitude, taken_at ) VALUES ( #{catId}, #{photoUrl}, CAST(#{embedding} AS vector), #{memo}, #{tags}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{takenAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, s.photo_url, c.created_at AS first_seen_at FROM cats c JOIN sightings s ON s.cat_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{catId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.taken_at, s.id LIMIT 1
SELECT tags FROM sightings WHERE cat_id = #{catId} AND tags != '' ORDER BY taken_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, seq, latitude, longitude, taken_at, memo FROM ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY taken_at ASC) AS seq, latitude, longitude, taken_at, memo FROM sightings WHERE cat_id = #{catId} ) t WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY taken_at DESC

SELECT id, seq, photo_url, taken_at, memo, tags AS tag_value FROM ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY taken_at ASC) AS seq, photo_url, taken_at, memo, tags FROM sightings WHERE cat_id = #{catId} ) t ORDER BY taken_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
